description: This file initializes a React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the root React DOM node and wraps the App component with React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React components into the created DOM root.
